description: Smoke-test set against the generated fake rulebook (evals/fixtures/fake-rulebook.pdf). Use it to check the pipeline end-to-end before the real rulebooks are in assets/rulebooks/.

questions.question: I have 3 energy left and a Battery at the end of my turn. What happens to my energy?
questions.expected_quote: keeps up to 2 unused energy instead of discarding them

questions.question: and if I don't have one?
questions.expected_quote: you must discard all unused energy

questions.question: Can I give 2 of my energy to my partner?
questions.expected_verdict: No: energy may not be traded between players unless a card explicitly says so.
questions.expected_quote: Energy may not be traded between players at any time

questions.question: Where is the scoring track shown?
questions.expected_verdict: In Figure 1 on the Special plants page (lower half of the page).

questions.question: Is the Windmill affected by weather cards?
questions.expected_verdict: Not covered: the rulebook has no weather cards.
